posts.title: Soft Blush Nails for a Timeless Look
posts.excerpt: A delicate blush manicure is an easy way to keep your nails looking polished and understated.
posts.body:
Soft blush nails are a lovely choice when you want a manicure that feels elegant without asking for attention. Choose a sheer pink or milky rose shade and finish with a glossy top coat.

For a little variation, add one tiny pearl detail or keep every nail beautifully simple. This look works for everyday plans, special occasions and everything in between.

posts.title: The Art of the Minimal French Tip
posts.excerpt: A fresh, fine-line take on the classic French manicure.
posts.body:
The modern French manicure is all about a light touch. Start with a sheer nude base, then add a very fine tip in soft white, cream or a colour you love.

Keep the line delicate and the shape comfortable for your nails. A glossy finish brings the whole look together.

posts.title: Neutral Tones, Beautifully Layered
posts.excerpt: Build an easy outfit around cream, camel and warm earthy shades.
posts.body:
Neutral outfits feel considered when you mix textures as well as colours. Try a soft knit with tailored trousers, or layer a light jacket over a simple top.

Keep the palette to two or three complementary shades. A small accessory can add personality without making the outfit feel busy.

posts.title: Tiny Floral Nail Art to Try
posts.excerpt: Small floral details bring a gentle, playful touch to a simple manicure.
posts.body:
Tiny flowers can turn a plain manicure into something personal. Choose a neutral base and add a small flower on one or two nails.

You can keep the petals tonal for a subtle finish or use a soft contrasting shade. Let each layer dry before adding the next.

posts.title: A Capsule Wardrobe Starting Point
posts.excerpt: A few versatile pieces can make getting dressed feel much simpler.
posts.body:
A useful capsule wardrobe begins with pieces that work well together. Think of a comfortable pair of trousers, a well-fitting everyday top, a layer for cooler days and shoes you enjoy wearing.

Choose colours that complement one another and add a few details that reflect your own taste. The goal is flexibility, not a strict list.

posts.title: Milky White Nails, Made Simple
posts.excerpt: A soft, milky finish that looks clean, bright and beautifully understated.
posts.body:
Milky white nails sit somewhere between sheer and opaque. Apply thin coats over a neatly prepared nail, building the colour slowly until you like the finish.

A rounded or softly squared shape pairs especially well with this simple style. Finish with a clear top coat for shine.

posts.title: Effortless Weekend Outfit Ideas
posts.excerpt: Comfortable outfit combinations that still feel thoughtfully put together.
posts.body:
For an easy weekend outfit, begin with one comfortable piece and build around it. Relaxed denim, a soft shirt and a light layer make a versatile combination.

A neat bag or simple jewellery can bring the look together. Choose pieces that suit your plans and feel comfortable throughout the day.

posts.title: A Hint of Chrome Nail Inspiration
posts.excerpt: A subtle pearly sheen adds a little light without feeling overdone.
posts.body:
Chrome details can be as subtle or as noticeable as you like. For a softer effect, choose a pearly finish over a pale neutral base.

Keep the rest of the manicure simple so the finish has room to shine. Save a reference image and ask your nail artist which products suit your preferred look.
